package provides a standalone development tools interface for managing translations. It includes a Vite plugin for automatic integration and a universal bridge system for framework-agnostic i18n support.
is a self-contained package that provides:
- Automatic button injection and API endpoints
- Framework-agnostic bridge creation for any i18n implementation
- Custom element for the DevTools UI
- List, load, and save translation files via API
Install the package using your preferred package manager:
language-bash shiki shiki-themes material-theme-lighter material-theme material-theme-palenight
The easiest way to use DevTools is through the Vite plugin, which automatically injects a floating button and provides all necessary API endpoints:
language-typescript shiki shiki-themes material-theme-lighter material-theme material-theme-palenight
// Optional: automatically inject floating button (default: true)
The plugin automatically injects a floating button in the bottom right corner of your application:
- Button hides when cursor is far away (>200px)
- Even when hidden, a small part remains visible for easy access
- Transitions and hover effects for better UX
- Button fully appears when you hover over the visible part
The plugin provides the following API endpoints:
Get list of all translation files and directory structure.

The package exports a custom element that can be used directly:
language-javascript shiki shiki-themes material-theme-lighter material-theme material-theme-palenight

- Files can only be accessed within the configured project root

- The plugin is automatically excluded from production builds
- No code is included in production bundles
